global_rules: Do not reacquire or rebuild a dataset when an authenticated hash-bound surface already exists unless byte contradiction is found.
Direct measurement, structural feature coverage, predicted transport and biological replication are separate evidence classes.
Donor is the primary biological replication unit.
Unavailable evidence is missing, never zero.
Technology/source is an observation operator, not biology.
No protected disease/pathology outcome selects the foundation target or rare program.
No multimodal evidence rescues a failed foundation candidate.
No single weighted cross-modality evidence score is authorized.
